network = "Required to download web resources for import"
status_meaning: Executed import/export behavior probe; consult retention_status for preservation.
loss_interpretation: Inspect imported primitive types and output node counts: geometry can be baked or omitted.
Classic stock path advertises X3D 3.3; the ecosystem fork has its own modern 4.0 path.
This fixture is separate from the owned packet geometry adapter and its coordinate/metadata contract.
